sentence_stem: Mount Everest is the highest mountain in the world, so
correct_completion: it is taller than any other mountain.
full_sentence: Mount Everest is the highest mountain in the world, so it is taller than any other mountain.
acceptable_variants: it is taller than all the other mountains.
no other mountain is higher than it.

options.text: it is the shortest of all mountains.
options.why_wrong: This contradicts 'the highest', so it cannot be the logical result of that superlative.

options.text: it is taller than any other mountain.
it is the oldest mountain in the world.
options.why_wrong: Age is a different quality, and 'the highest' does not tell us anything about how old a mountain is.

options.text: it is the most beautiful mountain of all.
options.why_wrong: Beauty is a matter of opinion and does not follow logically from being the highest.

grammar_focus: Superlative adjectives and the logical result they imply
explanation: The superlative 'the highest' implies a comparison with all other items in the group, so the logical result must also be a comparison of height. Choose the option that repeats that comparison.
translation: O Monte Everest é a montanha mais alta do mundo, por isso é mais alto do que qualquer outra montanha.
